newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER'S BLUNDER GIVES PARAGUAY WIN OVER CHILE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER'S BLUNDER GIVES PARAGUAY WIN OVER CHILE.

text.p: A blunder by Chile goalkeeper Nelson Cossio handed Paraguay a 1-0 win in the opening game of the Copa America on Wednesday.
Cossio, one of several reserves in an understrength Chile team, allowed a tame shot by midfielder Roberto Acuna to slip under his body in the 28th minute.

Chile, like many other teams in the competition, opted to leave many of their top players at home to give them a rest as the tournament is sandwiched between South American qualifiers for the World Cup. Striker Ivan Zamorano is among the absentees.
Paraguay chose to bring most of their top players and had slightly the better of an uninspiring encounter in group A, which also contains Ecuador and Argentina.

Paraguay's fiery goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert, who has imposed a media silence since arriving in Bolivia, seemed disinterested and was only noticed when he overstepped to give Chile their best chance of the game.
However, the Chileans wasted the chance by firing their free kick straight into the defensive wall.
Chilavert was also powerless in the second half when a fulminating 25-metre drive by Jorge Gomez blasted against the crossbar in Chile's best attack.
